workflow.title: Review large and old Mac files without treating age as permission to delete
workflow.primaryIntent: Use Aiseesoft’s size/age categories as a review queue, distinguishing archived originals from reproducible data before any cleanup.
workflow.descriptionDirection: Answer first: a size or age bucket narrows inspection; it does not establish that a file is disposable. Describe documented controls, not a tested cleanup result.
sections: Read the size and age buckets as filters, not a deletion verdict
Follow the documented Scan → View → select workflow, stopping before Clean for review
Check ownership, backup and rebuild/download cost for each candidate
Distinguish a one-off file inventory from investigating recurring growth
Choose the documented utility or the qualified Breathing Room preview for the actual task
workflow.visualPlan: Official Large & Old Files UI after the lead only once rights clear; current-source Breathing Room Space example preview later with full caption.
workflow.interactionPass: Handoff a non-mutating decision checklist: know owner? sole original? backup verified? reproducible? current project dependency? Any unknown means keep/investigate, not delete. No invented scan, savings or checkbox that authorizes machine changes.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs Aiseesoft Mac Cleaner
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose between category-based Mac cleanup and storage-owner/activity investigation with a preview caveat.
comparison.format: Concise sourced matrix, one disclosed recommendation arc, installation/hosted/pricing caveats and link to workflow article.

aiseesoftAdvantages: Documents selectable large/old-file size and age categories and broader duplicate/photo/uninstaller utilities; potentially useful for a one-off review. Vendor-described, not hands-on verified.
aiseesoftTradeoffs: Compatibility wording conflicts; exact version, recovery semantics, trial limits and offline/telemetry behavior unknown.
Promotional prices must include separate bundled player renewal warning and qualified refund language.
breathingRoomAdvantages: Breathing Room, which we build, has source-supported owner/project exploration, app/helper grouping and activity history; useful when the question is what keeps growing, not merely which file is old.
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Non-notarized preview with Python prerequisite and incomplete native/release QA; hosted AI needs authentication/internet and optional AI Care is paid.
No equivalent duplicate-photo utility or complete uninstaller verified; no blanket claim of safety, privacy or superior performance.
